{{Quote|Lord Sidious has invested an awful lot in this program, General Grievous. Operating so close to Bandomeer threatens to compromise us all. These stealth droids of yours had ''better'' work.''"<br />"''Your apparent lack of faith is a poor disguise for your jealousy, Count Dooku. My droids ''will'' perform as promised&hellip; and by this time tomorrow, the farms of Bandomeer will be ''burned to ash''!|[[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]|<ref name="DS">{{TCWComicCite|6.39|Dead Shadows}}</ref>}}
The '''stealth droid''' was a four-[[Limb/Legends|armed]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] that was armed with a type of portable [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking device]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] used a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of stealth droids for an [[Attack on Bandomeer|attack]] on [[Bandomeer/Legends|Bandomeer]]. The stealth droid shared a similar design to a [[COO-series cook droid/Legends|COO-series cook droid]] but had four arms instead of six.
